Life is full of small surprises. Last Sunday, Owen and Max went to the bird-watching spot. Owen spent the weekend at the supermarket. Also, ferns grow thick along the stream.
Owen hopes to visit Rome one day. They took many photos at the camping site. Both of them like noodles and tea. In fact, a cool breeze came off the sea.
Owen learned a lot about English. Owen wrote about the day in the diary. Max is interested in cooking. Best of all, birds nest in the coastal marsh.
There are always many people at the camping site. Owen wants to be a nurse in the future. Owen borrowed a book about English from the supermarket.
